description: Zhang Fei, stocky Chinese warrior in approved pixel art style, black beard and topknot, red headband with two tails, dark armor with gold borders and red cloth, black boots, long dark spear with large silver wavy serpent blade. Front view.
action: One front-facing straight spear thrust toward the camera, then recover fully to the supplied idle pose. Frames 1-5: the front LEFT hand smoothly approaches and closes onto the shaft; the RIGHT rear hand holds the shaft throughout. Frames 5-11: both hands grip, step forward and thrust toward the camera, with natural foreshortening. Frames 12-15: recover through the reversed preparation poses 4,3,2,1, smoothly returning the front hand to the original idle position. Follow the supplied skeleton. No teleport, no hand jitter, no weapon stretching. Preserve the large wavy blade and all of the shaft. Keep the headband knot attached to the head and both tails attached to the knot, following the supplied headband points. Fixed south/front camera, no camera rotation, no effects or afterimages. Last pose matches the first pose.
